title: (Deprecated) Get the results of an async task
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the results of an async task. If the task completes (`status` = `SUCCESS`), you can call [/dynamic_scene/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740317360823297) to download videos that are generated from the material package you submit. > **Note**
The Dynamic Scene API is now in beta. If you would like access to this feature, please apply for the allowlisting using the [Allowlist Management](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/blog/detail/7102266224578396162) page. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/dynamic_scene/task/get/| /v1.3/dynamic_scene/task/get/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number |`advertiser_id`: string | |Response parameter name|`url` |`video_preview_url` | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/dynamic_scene/task/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string| Advertiser ID. | |task_id|string|Task ID, in the response of [/dynamic_scene/task/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740317320231938) endpoint.| ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object|Returned data.| #|status|string|Status of the task. Enum values: `PROCESSING`, `FAIL`, `SUCCESS`.| #|error_msg|string|The error massage if the task has exceptions.| #|material_package_id|string|The mapping material package ID of the task. | #|available_quota|number|The number of videos remaining in your quota. You can create a new task to generate more videos, but the number of videos is not allowed to exceed the remaining quota. | #|videos|object[]|Max size=8, Videos created by Dynamic Scene API.| ##|music_id|string|Music ID. | ##|music_name|string|Music name. | ##|music_preview_url |string|Music preview link. | ##|width|number| Video width.| ##|height|number| Video height.| ##|duration|number|Video Duration (seconds). | ##|story_arc|string[]|Refers to the structure and shape of a story, consisting of multiple slots.| ##|video_id|string|Video ID. You can use it to create Ads.| ##|video_preview_url|string|Preview link of the video. Notice that the period of validity is 24 hours. | ##|slots |object[]|Slot information.| ###|order |number|The order of slot in the story arc, ranging from 0 to 5.| ###|tag |string|The tag of a slot.| ###|video_ids|string[]|Video materials.| ###|mute|boolean|Whether to turn on the soundtrack in a slot. | ###|bgm_volume|number|The volume of background music, as an integer, ranging from [0, 100].| seo_title: Get results of an async TikTok Dynamic Scene task via API
seo_description: Use this endpoint to get the results of an async Dynamic Scene task. Find the detailed parameters and accepted values.
